newsitem.title: UK: MAM gains as SBC Warburg repeats "buy".
newsitem.headline: MAM gains as SBC Warburg repeats "buy".

text.p: Shares in Mercury Asset Management Plc, one of the UK's biggest fund management groups, rose on Thursday after analysts at SBC Warburg repeated a "buy" recommendation on the stock, market sources said.
The shares were up 24p at 10.51-1/2 stg by 0907 GMT, after earlier touching a record 10.62-3/4 stg.

Sources said Warburg analysts had said they expected a good set of first-half results when MAM reports next month and said the company could benefit from well-publicised problems at rival major fund management houses.
